learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the rules, field layouts, tactical formations, teamwork dynamics, and key skills of major team games like Football, Basketball, Volleyball, and Hockey!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: ड्रिबल (गेंद को नियंत्रण में ले जाना)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Played by two teams of 11 players. Important concepts include passing, dribbling, heading, offside rules, penalty kicks, and tactical formations like 4-4-2 or 4-3-3.
A fast-paced court game focusing on dribbling, passing (chest pass, bounce pass), shooting (lay-up, jump shot), rebounding, and man-to-man vs. zone defense.
Involves 6 players per side using skills like the serve, forearm pass (bump), overhead set, spike, and block. The Libero plays a specialized defensive role in a different colored jersey.
Requires stick control for dribbling, pushing, scooping, and hitting. Penalty corners and penalty strokes are critical scoring opportunities.

fun_activity.title: 🏀 The Figure-8 Dribble
fun_activity.instructions: Take a basketball (or any bouncy ball) and practice passing it between and around your legs in a 'Figure-8' loop without dropping it. Once comfortable, try doing it while bouncing the ball!

exam_tips: 📌 Be able to draw and label the court/field dimensions for Basketball or Volleyball with correct line markings.
📌 Clearly define the specialized role and restrictions of the 'Libero' in Volleyball (cannot serve, spike from front row, or block).
📌 Explain the 'Offside rule' in Football simply and clearly with a small positional sketch.
quick_recap: ⭐ A standard football match consists of two halves of 45 minutes each.
⭐ In Basketball, a shot made from beyond the three-point line awards 3 points.
⭐ Team games develop leadership, communication, and collective problem-solving under pressure.
